sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Located in the Usera neighborhood of Madrid , Doble Erre transforms a former cold storage facility for a pastry business into a hybrid infrastructure for practices at the intersection of art, design, and technology. The project spans 215 m2 distributed across exhibition areas, workshops, a kitchen, and an exterior courtyard, configuring an environment for contemporary cultural production. It was designed by Morphism, a studio focused on spatial design, interior design, and architecture led by Aquiles Jarrin, in collaboration with Lautaro Bianchi.
